name: integration_test
summary: Flutter SDK integration-testing support for exercising a complete Flutter application on a target device or emulator.
advantages: Tests behavior of the complete Flutter application
Can run on devices or emulators and use flutter_test APIs
tradeoffs: Slower and more expensive to run than unit or widget tests
Flutter documentation notes that integration_test cannot interact with native platform UI
recommendedFor: Testing multiple app components together on a target device

verification.reason: Flutter official integration-testing documentation is sufficient.
